unit.why: A brief memorate, heard from the author's father-in-law, describing R. Nahman's heart-rending groaning in prayer and the Besht's praise of him; it is closer to an anecdote than a bare saying.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מחמי ז"ל כשר' נחמן גנוחי
stories.summary_en: R. Nahman's groan during prayer broke the hearts of those who heard it, and the Besht said that only where R. Nahman had travelled do people know what prayer is.

tags.why: R. Nahman's manner of prayer is the subject
the point is to praise R. Nahman's prayer

quotes: אמר הבעש״ט עד מקום שנסע ר׳ נחמן
tags.why: the Besht praises his associate R. Nahman
R. Nahman's travels spread true prayer

missing_concepts: groaning/sighing (גניחה) in prayer as a spiritual force
